notes.title: Sherlock Holmes The Awakened gets its first gameplay trailer and it's kinda creepy
notes.content:
Frogwares have released the first gameplay trailer for Sherlock Holmes The Awakened, and it's a bit creepy.

The Sherlock meets Cthulhu horror adventure sees a young Sherlock and John Watson undertake a chilling case that will forever "bond and scar the duo."

What seems like a straightforward case of a missing person quickly spirals into a web of conspiracies by a cult that worships Cthulhu and are attempting to bring about an ancient prophecy.

Read more

notes.title: Sherlock Holmes: The Awakened trailer shows first gameplay from the Lovecraft mash-up
notes.content:
It’s been a minute since we last saw anything from Frogwares’ kitbashed remake of their 2007 mystery horror game Sherlock Holmes: The Awakened. Now though, a new trailer gives a proper glimpse of what Holmes and Watson will be getting up to when they take on H.P. Lovecraft’s Cthulhu Mythos, once again for the very first time. Have a watch below, and try not to get lost in an ethereal netherworld inhabited by malevolent, sleeping gods.

Read more

notes.title: Sherlock Holmes: The Awakened remake now has a trailer and Kickstarter
notes.content:
My first encounter with Frogwares' Sherlock Holmes games was the Consolevania drubbing of Sherlock Holmes: The Awakened, but the series has come a long way since. Alice loved last year's Sherlock Holmes: Chapter One, which stars a young, hot Holmes.

As CJ reported last week, Frogwares now intend to close the circle by pitting hot Holmes against (hot?) Cthulhu creatures in a remake of 2007's The Awakened. Its Kickstarter project launched today and there's a reveal trailer below.

Read more

notes.title: Sherlock Holmes Chapter One | Combat Deep Dive Trailer
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Sherlock Holmes: Chapter One’s release date is getting closer and closer -  November 16th to be exact. To give you a further glimpse of how the game plays, we’ve prepared another trailer for you to check out. This time we wanted to give you a deeper dive into the game’s combat.

[previewyoutube=UgxDKSyyY_E;full][/previewyoutube]
Although smart, Sherlock is certainly not a gun-toting superhero maniac. He must use his wits and brains in battle the same way as he does when solving a crime. If the time to fight comes, look closely and find your opponent’s weak spots, take advantage of the environment itself, or use your snuff box to daze them if they come too close to stun them to gain an advantage. Remember though, Sherlock’s strongest weapon is his mind. Work clever, not hard. 

Killing is a last resort. If you do decide to gun down your foes, expect to hear about it from your companion Jon. It might impact how he perceives you. Having a disappointed Jon around you can be bad for your mental health.

However, if combat is not your thing, you can always choose to skip this part of the game by turning it off in the menu. 

And finally, remember that you can pre-order Sherlock Holmes Chapter One right now, and receive additional content as well as the full Sherlock Holmes: Crimes and Punishments game. Just click the link below. 


Take care and until next time detectives,

Yours Frogwares Team

notes.title: Frogwares games soundtracks are out now. All games -70%
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Music plays an integral part in any game. It is the underlying current that sets the scene, the feeling, and the tone of a game. We might not always notice it when it’s there, but if you take it away, you will definitely feel that something is not right. And the wrong music at the wrong time can feel more awkward than asking the name of a person you’ve already met.
Today, we decided to release the music and soundtracks from our games and we bundled them in four distinct packages. Here’s a little breakdown of one another.

[u]Sherlock Holmes Classic Soundtrack[/u]
Venture into the mysterious world of the Sherlock Holmes adventures with this original soundtrack that captures the enigmatic mood of the classic games. A must-have for fans of the brilliant detective or thrilling orchestra music.

Includes soundtracks from Sherlock Holmes: The Mystery of the Mummy, Sherlock Holmes: The Silver Earring, Sherlock Holmes: The Awakened - Remastered Edition, Sherlock Holmes – Nemesis, Sherlock Holmes versus Jack the Ripper.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1250110/Sherlock_Holmes_Franchise_Classic_Soundtrack/

[u]Sherlock Holmes Modern Soundtrack[/u]
Discover the enchanting vibes of Sherlock Holmes games through this original soundtrack that includes music from the latest three adventures. Combining the iconic sounds of classical orchestra instruments with a modern electronic ambient style, this collection offers more than 50 tracks and is available in MP3 320 kbps.

Includes soundtracks from The Testament of Sherlock Holmes, Sherlock Holmes: Crimes and Punishments, Sherlock Holmes: The Devil's Daughter.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1252260/Sherlock_Holmes_Franchise_Modern_Soundtrack/
 
[u]Frogwares Classic Games Soundtrack[/u]
From energizing dance rhythms in 80 Days, to soul-stirring gothic tones of Dracula, this soundtrack offers a nostalgic look back at the Frogwares classic games. This is not just music – this is an insight into how it all began almost two decades ago.

This soundtrack includes music from Journey to the Center of the Earth, 80 Days, Dracula: Origin, Dracula: Love Kills, Sherlock Holmes and The Hound of The Baskervilles, Department 42: The Mystery of the Nine, Secret Missions: Mata Hari and the Kaiser's Submarines, Sherlock Holmes and the Mystery of the Frozen City, Sherlock Holmes and The Mystery of Osborne House, Secret Mission: The Forgotten Island

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1250710/Frogwares_Games_Classic_Soundtrack/

We know that music is a powerful thing, and we hope that if you had a great time with our games, that these musical pieces will bring back some of those memories. And if you haven’t played our games before, and you’re tempted to take the plunge, our games are now -70% off on Steam. If there ever was a time to try, it’s basically now. 


Regards,

Frogwares team

notes.title: Have You Played Sherlock Holmes: The Awakened?
notes.content:
Have You Played? is an endless stream of game retrospectives. One a day, every day of the year, perhaps for all time.

I was recently most entertained by reviews of the utterly bloody awful Sherlock Holmes: The Devil’s Daughter, a game actually slightly better than the previously abysmal Crimes & Punishments, as people who’d madly claimed to rate the earlier game suddenly realised what a pile of shite it had all been. But impressively, both represent a huge step forward for the amazingly dreadful series which has been being terrible for over a decade. The Awakened appeared ten years ago.

… [visit site to read more]
